d: Yemen's Houthi rebels have launched fresh strikes on Saudi Arabia, targeting Riyadh, Jizan and the Red Sea coast. Explosions were heard in Riyadh as authorities issued an alert over a ‘hostile aerial threat’ on November 21. The Saudi-led coalition says it intercepted and destroyed three ballistic missiles and two more over Jizan, where debris fell in Al-Shuqaiq. The escalation follows Saudi-led coalition strikes on November 20 targeting Houthi operational capabilities, weapons-smuggling operations and military sites in Hodeida, Sanaa, Saada and Taiz.
